brand_essence: A distinctive, editorial, high-end specialty noodle retail and franchise destination that treats authentic regional noodles like single-origin coffees or grand cru wines. It brings curated artisanal noodles from Japan, Korea, China, Thailand, Vietnam, Indonesia, India, and World Specials under one roof with an experiential 'Try & Buy' tasting bar model.
design_archetype: Organic & Earthy meets Swiss Editorial Luxury (Artisanal Food Provenance with Crisp Botanical Ink and Gold Seals)

color_palette.primary_description: NoodleWala Signature Forest Green - used for primary key brand moments, primary CTAs, active status, badges
color_palette.deep_green_ink_description: Deep Green/Ink - used for authoritative headers, hero banners, statement quote bands, dark contrasting footer
color_palette.dark_text_green_description: Primary high-contrast body & title text on light backgrounds (ensures 10:1+ APCA/WCAG contrast)
color_palette.secondary_green_description: Secondary Green - used for secondary tags, origin highlights, filter pills, map markers
color_palette.gold_accent_description: Craft Gold Accent - used exclusively for premium origin crests, tasting award stamps, 'Try & Buy' badges, authentic certified stamps, star ratings
color_palette.light_background_description: Warm porcelain matcha-hued canvas background - provides breathing room, warmth, organic tactile depth
color_palette.white_description: Pure crisp surface cards, floating menus, modals, and store cards with subtle borders
color_palette.muted_text_description: Secondary metadata, broth notes, provenance origin coordinates, opening hours
color_palette.border_stroke_description: Subtle structured 1px botanical line for cards, tables, grid borders and separators

forbidden_styles: Overly playful cartoon noodle graphics or mascot illustrations
Generic restaurant takeout template layouts with red/yellow fast-food palettes
Cheap gradients (>20% opacity) or generic SaaS purple/blue #7351B7 gradients
Inter or default sans-serif font for H1/H2 headings
Center-everything disease without dynamic asymmetric editorial tension
Transparent dropdowns, transparent headers without blur/solid fill

key_user_journeys_and_surfaces.requirements: Fixed/sticky with backdrop blur bg-[#F7FAF6]/90 border-b border-[#D7E4DC]. Left: Logo 'NoodleWala.com' with gold noodle swirl crest and tagline 'The World of Noodles'. Center desktop nav links: 'Home', 'Shop Noodles', 'Origin Collections', 'Try & Buy', 'Store Locator', 'Franchise', 'About'. Right CTA cluster: 'FIND A STORE' (secondary ghost button) + 'GET A FRANCHISE' (primary high-contrast button in #00704A with gold micro-accent) + Cart pill drawer + Mobile hamburger menu.

sections.name: Hero Section
sections.details: Editorial split-asymmetric layout. Left: Eyebrow 'ORIGIN-CERTIFIED SPECIALTY RETAIL', H1 'The Grand Tour of World Noodles.', subtext explaining 80+ rare noodles from Tokyo to Bandung available in single packs & experiential tasting. CTAs: 'Explore Catalog' and 'Book Try & Buy Sampling'. Right: High-impact hero image with floating gold badge '8 Origins • 120+ Artisanal Varieties' and live counter 'Tasted by 45,000+ noodle lovers'.

sections.name: Brand Credo / Marquee Ribbon

sections.name: Explore by Origin Grid
sections.details: 8 Curated Origin destinations: Japan (Ramen & Soba), Korea (Ramyeon & Jjajang), China (Dan Dan & Hand-pulled), Thailand (Pad Thai & Tom Yum), Vietnam (Pho & Bun Bo), Indonesia (Mie Goreng & Laksa), India (Desi Hakka & Masala Wheat), and World Specials (Italian Truffle Somen, Singapore Katong). Each with country flag, spice index, signature broth type, and direct filter link.

sections.name: Featured Products Bento
sections.details: Interactive product cards with instant 'Quick View', 'Add to Cart', heat indicator (mild to extra fiery), pack size, price in INR, and 'Try & Buy Available' badge.

sections.name: The Try & Buy Experience Promo
sections.details: Editorial feature block detailing the 3-step ritual: 1. Pick any noodle from shelf -> 2. Chef prepares a 90ml tasting cup at the live bar -> 3. Fall in love & take home the full crate. Direct CTA to locate a participating store.

sections.name: Franchise Callout Band
sections.details: Deep green ink background (#063B2B) with gold foil accent typography: 'Bring NoodleWala to Your City. Low Capex, High Footfall Experiential Retail & Tasting Bar Model.' Button: 'Request Franchise Dossier'.

sections.name: Store Discovery Teaser
sections.details: Quick city selector (Mumbai, Delhi-NCR, Bengaluru, Pune, Hyderabad, Chennai) showing live open status, today's sample broth on tap, and directions.

key_user_journeys_and_surfaces.features: Search bar with debounce, multi-facet filtering (Origin, Heat 1-5, Diet: Veg/Non-Veg/Vegan, Style: Broth/Stir-Fry/Cold), Sort by Popularity, Spice Level, Price. Product card includes photo, tags, customer rating, price, 'Add to Cart' with quantity stepper, and 'Quick View' modal with nutrition breakdown and authentic recipe notes.

Deep-dive into culinary heritage for Japan, Korea, China, Thailand, Vietnam, Indonesia, India, and World Specials. Each with historical context, wheat/flour milling tradition, spice profile, and filtered inventory.

Interactive tasting guide: how it works, today's rotating tasting menu (e.g. 'Tuesday Tonkotsu Tasting', 'Thursday Thai Fire'), list of participating flagship stores with tasting bar slots, and instant sample reservation modal.

Filter by city, search by pincode or locality, check which stores have 'Live Try & Buy Tasting Bar', 'Artisanal Fresh Noodle Counter', parking availability, opening hours, one-click WhatsApp store inquiry, and Google Maps mock link.

Comprehensive business deck presentation: Unit economics (Store FOCO/FOFO formats: Kiosk 250 sqft, High-Street Retail 600 sqft, Experience Flagship 1200 sqft), ROI timeline (14-18 months), Support pillars (Supply chain direct from 8 nations, bar training, POS ERP). Multi-step interactive Franchise Application Form with instant validation and submission feedback.
Our Genesis: How founders traveled 14 Asian culinary regions to build India's first authentic specialty noodle retail haven. Ethical sourcing statement, noodle sommelier team, and quality pledge.

key_user_journeys_and_surfaces.surface: Customer Care & Support Portal with Ticket Management
key_user_journeys_and_surfaces.features: Dual mode: 1. Create a Support Ticket (Order Issue, Store Feedback, Quality Inquiry, Franchise Support) with unique generated NW-TICKET-ID; 2. Live Ticket Status Check tab allowing users to enter ticket number and see stage (Received, Reviewing, Resolved).

key_user_journeys_and_surfaces.surface: Floating AI Sommelier Chat Launcher & Window
key_user_journeys_and_surfaces.features: Persistent bottom-right floating trigger with gold noodle badge. When opened: interactive 'NoodleWala AI Sommelier' capable of answering: 'Recommend a mild broth noodle', 'Which Korean noodle has real black bean paste?', 'What time does the Indiranagar store tasting bar close?', 'How to apply for franchise?' with smart quick prompt chips.

Dark Ink (#063B2B) contrast footer with oversized brand typography 'NOODLEWALA.COM', newsletter signup with gold submit button, certified stamps, origin countries list, franchise direct desk, customer care WhatsApp, copyright, and social links.

accessibility_and_testing.wcag_compliance: WCAG AA and APCA high-legibility guidelines. Text on background has minimum 8:1 contrast.
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attribute: Every interactive button, input, tab, filter pill, modal trigger, card, and submit button MUST have a unique data-testid in kebab-case format.
accessibility_and_testing.keyboard_nav: Full tab order with visible focus ring (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#00704A] focus:outline-none).

mock_data_and_features.cart_state: Client-side interactive slide-out cart with line items, quantity adjustment, subtotal, free shipping progress bar, and checkout simulation modal.
mock_data_and_features.ticket_state: Pre-seeded with 2 existing tickets (e.g. NW-8492 for Try&Buy reservation and NW-7301 for Store Inquiry) so users can immediately test the 'Check Ticket Status' functionality, plus interactive form to generate new ones.
mock_data_and_features.chat_ai: Intelligent client-side conversational AI Sommelier with curated culinary knowledge base and instant natural language answers + quick reply chips.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the full multi-page experience cleanly inside the existing React single-page app architecture using react-router-dom or view-state routing with clean URL hash / path navigation.

Strictly honor the user's fixed color palette: Primary #00704A, Deep Green #063B2B, Dark Text #123D2D, Secondary #1B8A63, Gold Accent #C9A227, Light BG #F7FAF6, White #FFFFFF, Muted #5F6F67, Border #D7E4DC.
Load Google Fonts Playfair Display and IBM Plex Sans in index.html to guarantee distinct editorial luxury.
Ensure all interactive buttons, inputs, filter chips, cart buttons, and form triggers carry clear data-testid attributes.
Ensure the floating AI assistant chat is accessible from any page, and the dedicated Customer Care page features both Ticket Creation and Status Lookup.
Make the Try & Buy sampling experience prominent throughout the site — it is NoodleWala's unique experiential differentiator.
